screens.method: git rev-list --objects --all; retain paths matching light_engine/effects/[^/]+.py or light_engine/analysis/wled_audio_sync.py including nested copies; deduplicate Git blob IDs; git cat-file blob; inspect all 101 versions for source-notice keywords and distinctive >=4-digit/hex numeric constants.
screens.headerDiffSearch: git log --all -p -- light_engine/effects; search added/deleted lines for word-bounded WLED|Copyright|FastLED|EUPL|MIT License|Aldick|Schwinne.
screens.headerCaveat: No such removal observed in reachable effect diffs. Root snapshots cannot reveal earlier removal. This is not a proof that no notice was ever removed.

commentScreen.method: For all 101 blobs, deduplicate full Python # comment lines containing >=6 whitespace-delimited words. Lowercase and replace non-[a-z0-9] runs with spaces. Test every contiguous six-word phrase against similarly normalized full upstream extractions.
commentScreen.limitations: Lexical screen only; excludes docstrings, code semantics, identifier renaming, translated comments, line wrapping, other upstream files/versions. Zero matches is not copyright clearance.

comparisons.upstream: wled-v16-fx:2157 onward, mode_fire_2012; v0.14.4 Fire2012 also reviewed
comparisons.sharedIdea: Cooling, upward heat transport, random ignition, heat rendering.
comparisons.localExpression: Float lerp from prior same cell and previous lower cell, SHA-256-derived per-strip/tick RNG, 60Hz replay, authored RGB multiplied by heat.
comparisons.observation: Specific weighted two-cell stencil, timing, integer state, ignition and palette expressions differ; shared four-stage idea remains. No numerical-compatibility claim establishes independence by itself.

comparisons.localExpression: Fixed width/gap mask; discrete highlighted band selected by floor(time*rate), initially none.
comparisons.observation: WLED Running/Saw coordinate waveform mechanism differs from fixed-mask/single-highlight mechanism.

comparisons.upstream: wled-v16-fx:6651 onward, mode_ripplepeak; ordinary ripple_base also reviewed
comparisons.sharedIdea: Peak-driven expanding ripples; both use a 16-ripple/wave bound.
comparisons.localExpression: Rising-edge events store birth/motion times, normalized origin and own gain weights; triangular spatial envelope with real-time exponential decay.
comparisons.observation: Power-of-two bound alone is weak evidence; WLED byte-state switch and palette/frequency mapping are not reproduced by the inspected expressions.

comparisons.upstream: wled-v16-fx:432 onward, mode_breath; v0.14.4 counterpart reviewed
comparisons.localExpression: Ordinary floating-point sine with cue/delta time and optional triangle/smoothstep.
comparisons.observation: WLED integer folded-counter expression differs. Pre-baseline authorship is not recoverable.

comparisons.upstream: wled-v16-fx:655 onward, mode_twinkle; v0.14.4 counterpart reviewed
comparisons.localExpression: Density*length*delta-time spawn accumulation, per-pixel retained colors, exponential decay.
comparisons.observation: Different state evolution from WLED incremental seeded selection; no matching distinctive local numeric constants found.

comparisons.localExpression: Hashed lattice value noise, four-corner separable quintic interpolation.
comparisons.observation: The inspected local code does not call or reproduce the inspected WLED Perlin/palette recipe. Quintic smoothing polynomial is a common mathematical mechanism, not alone evidence of copied source.

comparisons.sharedIdea: Public 44-byte V2 packet layout, header version, FFT width and multicast interoperability.
comparisons.localExpression: Python struct unpacking with finite/range validation and generic feature normalization.
comparisons.observation: Identical packet fields/constants are required for interoperability; this is not matching renderer expression. No broad no-copy declaration is relied upon.

exactDistinctiveExpression.local: light_engine/effects/coherent_noise.py:31-35 (current working tree after owner comment correction)
exactDistinctiveExpression.unmatchedContext: Current local spatial/time pre-mixing at lines29-30 and float normalization at36 differ from the source generator state increment; before comment correction these were28-29 and35.
exactDistinctiveExpression.finding: The local finalizer uses the same distinctive five-operation expression as the published SplitMix64 mixer. This is stronger than a generic algorithm-name resemblance but does not prove which historical source the author read.
exactDistinctiveExpression.licenseFinding: Primary source explicitly dedicates rights to public domain to extent legally possible and grants unconditional use/copy/modify/distribute permission. No attribution condition appears in that header.
exactDistinctiveExpression.remedy: Owner completed comment-only correction: current lines23-27 identify SplitMix64 and primary source. Original own-origin wording was at historical lines23-24. Preserve source/permission evidence; no algorithm replacement or WLED/EUPL relicensing follows from this finding.
